theorem frege_infinity_realizes (hInf : P.AxiomOfInfinity σ)
    (n : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (hn : FiniteCardinality n) : ∃ X, n X

theorem frege_infinity_suc_injective (hInf : P.AxiomOfInfinity σ)
    (n m : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (hn : FiniteCardinality n)
    (hm : FiniteCardinality m) (he : SucCard n = SucCard m) : n = m

theorem core_quantified_infinity_iff
    (P : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (q : ((σ → Prop) → Prop) → ((σ → Prop) → Prop))
    (K : ((σ → Prop) → Prop) → Prop) (U : σ → Prop)
    (htests : NumberMapTests P q) (hPU : P U) (hU : ∀ u, U u)
    (hforward : ∀ n, FiniteCardinality n → K (q n))
    (honto : ∀ y, K y → ∃ n, FiniteCardinality n ∧ q n = y) :
    Classicism.P.AxiomOfInfinity σ ↔ ¬ ∃ y, K y ∧ y U

theorem core_number_inverse_graph (hInf : Classicism.P.AxiomOfInfinity σ)
    (P : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (q : ((σ → Prop) → Prop) → ((σ → Prop) → Prop))
    (K : ((σ → Prop) → Prop) → Prop)
    (hcovers : PropertyFieldCovers P) (htests : NumberMapTests P q)
    (honto : ∀ y, K y → ∃ n, FiniteCardinality n ∧ q n = y) :
    ∀ y, K y → ∃ n, NumberInverse K q y n ∧
      ∀ m, NumberInverse K q y m → m = n

theorem onto
    (hnd : □ (∀ p q : Prop, p ≠ q → □ (p ≠ q)))
    (c : μ) (f : μ → μ) (b : μ → μ → μ)
    (H : ν → Prop) (d : ν) (g : ν → ν) (k : ν → ν → ν) (q : μ → ν)
    (hH : Persistent H) (hd : H d) (hg : ∀ a, H a → H (g a))
    (hk : ∀ a z, H a → H z → H (k a z))
    (hq0 : q c = d) (hqf : ∀ x, H (q x) → q (f x) = g (q x))
    (hqb : ∀ x y, H (q x) → H (q y) → q (b x y) = k (q x) (q y))
    (y : ν) (hy : CoreCarrier H d g k y) :
    ∃ x, Carrier c f b x ∧ q x = y

theorem left_inverse
    (c : μ) (f : μ → μ) (b : μ → μ → μ)
    (H : ν → Prop) (d : ν) (g : ν → ν) (k : ν → ν → ν)
    (q : μ → ν) (l : ν → μ)
    (hd : H d) (hg : ∀ a, H a → H (g a))
    (hk : ∀ a z, H a → H z → H (k a z))
    (hq0 : q c = d) (hqf : ∀ x, H (q x) → q (f x) = g (q x))
    (hqb : ∀ x y, H (q x) → H (q y) → q (b x y) = k (q x) (q y))
    (hl0 : l d = c) (hlg : ∀ y, H y → l (g y) = f (l y))
    (hlk : ∀ y z, H y → H z → l (k y z) = b (l y) (l z))
    (x : μ) (hx : Carrier c f b x) : H (q x) ∧ l (q x) = x

theorem right_inverse_on_target (G : μ → Prop) (K : ν → Prop)
    (q : μ → ν) (l : ν → μ)
    (honto : ∀ y, K y → ∃ x, G x ∧ q x = y)
    (hl : ∀ x, G x → l (q x) = x)
    (y : ν) (hy : K y) : G (l y) ∧ q (l y) = y

theorem numberMap_onto (w : Prop) (hw : ActualWorld w)
    (y : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (hy : Numbers w y) :
    ∃ n, FiniteCardinality n ∧ numberMap w n = y

theorem quantified_infinity_iff (w : Prop) (hw : ActualWorld w) :
    Classicism.P.AxiomOfInfinity σ ↔
      ¬ ∃ y, Numbers w y ∧ y (BaseTop (σ := σ) w)

theorem numberMap_inverse_graph (w : Prop) (hw : ActualWorld w)
    (hInf : Classicism.P.AxiomOfInfinity σ) :
    ∀ y : (σ → Prop) → Prop, Numbers w y → ∃ n, NumberInverse (Numbers w) (numberMap w) y n ∧
      ∀ m, NumberInverse (Numbers w) (numberMap w) y m → m = n

theorem addition_iff (w : Prop) (hw : ActualWorld w)
    (hInf : Classicism.P.AxiomOfInfinity σ)
    (a b c : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (ha : FiniteCardinality a)
    (hb : FiniteCardinality b) (hc : FiniteCardinality c) :
    AddGraph a b c ↔ CoreAdd w (numberMap w a) (numberMap w b) (numberMap w c)

theorem multiplication_iff (w : Prop) (hw : ActualWorld w)
    (hInf : Classicism.P.AxiomOfInfinity σ)
    (a b c : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (ha : FiniteCardinality a)
    (hb : FiniteCardinality b) (hc : FiniteCardinality c) :
    MulGraph a b c ↔ CoreMul w (numberMap w a) (numberMap w b) (numberMap w c)

theorem order_iff (w : Prop) (hw : ActualWorld w)
    (hInf : Classicism.P.AxiomOfInfinity σ)
    (a b : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (ha : FiniteCardinality a)
    (hb : FiniteCardinality b) :
    LeGraph a b ↔ CoreLe w (numberMap w a) (numberMap w b)

theorem subset_roundtrip (w : Prop) (hw : ActualWorld w)
    (V : ((σ → Prop) → Prop) → Prop) (hV : Domain w (Numbers w) V) :
    SubsetPush w (fun n => V (numberMap w n)) = V

theorem binary_roundtrip (w : Prop) (hw : ActualWorld w)
    (R : ((σ → Prop) → Prop) → ((σ → Prop) → Prop) → Prop)
    (hR : Domain w (NumberBinarySupport w) R) :
    BinaryPush w (fun i j => R (numberMap w i) (numberMap w j)) = R

theorem core_number_induction (w : Prop) (hw : ActualWorld w)
    (V : ((σ → Prop) → Prop) → Prop) (hV : Domain w (Numbers w) V)
    (hzero : V (coreZero w))
    (hstep : ∀ y, Numbers w y → V y → V (coreSuc w y)) :
    ∀ y, Numbers w y → V y

theorem finite_fibre_union (A : σ → Prop) (R : σ → τ → Prop)
    (hA : Finite A) (hR : ∀ x, A x → Finite (R x)) : Finite (Image A R)

theorem finite_separated_family (A : σ → Prop) (H : τ → Prop)
    (E : σ → τ → Prop) (hA : Finite A)
    (hsep : ∀ u v, H u → H v → (∀ x, A x → (E x u ↔ E x v)) → u = v) :
    Finite H

theorem infinity_iff_realizes : Classicism.P.AxiomOfInfinity σ ↔
    ∀ n : (σ → Prop) → Prop, FiniteCardinality n → ∃ X, n X

theorem finite_self_injection_surjective (A : σ → Prop) (R : σ → σ → Prop)
    (hA : Finite A) (htotal : ∀ x, A x → ∃ y, R x y)
    (hclosed : ∀ x y, A x → R x y → A y)
    (hsingle : ∀ x y z, A x → R x y → R x z → y = z)
    (hinj : ∀ x z y, A x → A z → R x y → R z y → x = z) :
    ∀ y, A y → ∃ x, A x ∧ R x y

theorem noncollapse_iff_bottom_not_number :
    Noncollapse σ ↔ ¬ FiniteCardinality (Bottom (σ := σ))
theorem arithmeticI_iff_istar : ArithmeticI σ ↔ IStar σ

theorem finite_numbers_iff_bottom_number : Finite (FiniteCardinality (σ := σ)) ↔
    FiniteCardinality (Bottom (σ := σ))

theorem infinite_numbers_iff_dedekind : ¬ Finite (FiniteCardinality (σ := σ)) ↔
    DedekindInfinite (FiniteCardinality (σ := σ))

theorem synch_bijection (hσ : Noncollapse σ) (hρ : Noncollapse ρ) :
    (∀ x : (σ → Prop) → Prop, FiniteCardinality x →
      ∃ y : (ρ → Prop) → Prop, Synch x y) ∧
    (∀ y : (ρ → Prop) → Prop, FiniteCardinality y →
      ∃ x : (σ → Prop) → Prop, Synch x y) ∧
    (∀ x y z, Synch (σ := σ) (ρ := ρ) x y → Synch x z → y = z) ∧
    (∀ x z y, Synch (σ := σ) (ρ := ρ) x y → Synch z y → x = z)

theorem addition_iff (hσ : Noncollapse σ) (hρ : Noncollapse ρ)
    (a b c : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (A B C : (ρ → Prop) → Prop)
    (ha : Synch a A) (hb : Synch b B) (hc : Synch c C) :
    AddGraph a b c ↔ AddGraph A B C

theorem multiplication_iff (hσ : Noncollapse σ) (hρ : Noncollapse ρ)
    (a b c : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (A B C : (ρ → Prop) → Prop)
    (ha : Synch a A) (hb : Synch b B) (hc : Synch c C) :
    MulGraph a b c ↔ MulGraph A B C

theorem sum_cross_base (hσ : Noncollapse σ) (hρ : Noncollapse ρ)
    (a b c : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (A B C : (ρ → Prop) → Prop)
    (ha : Synch a A) (hb : Synch b B) (hc : Synch c C) :
    Arith.Sum σ a b c ↔ Arith.Sum ρ A B C

theorem prod_cross_base (hσ : Noncollapse σ) (hρ : Noncollapse ρ)
    (a b c : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (A B C : (ρ → Prop) → Prop)
    (ha : Synch a A) (hb : Synch b B) (hc : Synch c C) :
    Arith.Prod σ a b c ↔ Arith.Prod ρ A B C

theorem formula_transfer (hσ : Noncollapse σ) (hρ : Noncollapse ρ)
    {k : Nat} (φ : AForm k) :
    ∀ (η : NumEnv σ k) (θ : NumEnv ρ k), RelatedEnvs η θ →
      (readFormula φ η ↔ readFormula φ θ)

theorem sentence_transfer_of_arithmeticI (hσ : ArithmeticI σ) (hρ : ArithmeticI ρ)
    (φ : AForm 0) : readSentence σ φ ↔ readSentence ρ φ

theorem realized_or_bottom
    (c5 : □ (∀ p q : Prop, p ≠ q → □ (p ≠ q)))
    (n : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (hn : FiniteCardinality n) :
    (∃ X, n X) ∨ n = Bottom

theorem numerical_extensionality
    (c5 : □ (∀ p q : Prop, p ≠ q → □ (p ≠ q)))
    (m n : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (hm : FiniteCardinality m)
    (hn : FiniteCardinality n) (hext : ∀ X, m X ↔ n X) : m = n

theorem infinity_iff_arithmeticI
    (c5 : □ (∀ p q : Prop, p ≠ q → □ (p ≠ q))) :
    Classicism.P.AxiomOfInfinity σ ↔ ArithmeticI σ

theorem finite_base_iff_numbers
    (c5 : □ (∀ p q : Prop, p ≠ q → □ (p ≠ q))) :
    Finite (fun _ : σ => True) ↔ Finite (FiniteCardinality (σ := σ))

theorem finite_profiles_iff_coordinates (H : τ → Prop) (E : σ → τ → Prop)
    (h : UniqueProfiles H E) : Finite H ↔ Finite (fun _ : σ => True)

theorem profiles_no_injection (H : τ → Prop) (E : σ → τ → Prop)
    (hex : ProfilesExist H E) (R : τ → σ → Prop)
    (htotal : ∀ w, H w → ∃ x, R w x)
    (hinj : ∀ u v x, H u → H v → R u x → R v x → u = v) : False

theorem raw_uwr_infinity_iff (V : σ → Prop) (hV : RawUWR V) :
    Classicism.P.AxiomOfInfinity σ ↔ ¬ Finite (Atom (τ := Prop))

theorem finite_atoms_iff_propositions (hat : AtomicityT) :
    Finite (Atom (τ := Prop)) ↔ Finite (fun _ : Prop => True)

theorem raw_uwr_infinity_base_iff_propositions {σ : Type} [Ty σ]
    (V : σ → Prop) (hV : RawUWR V) (hat : AtomicityT) :
    AxiomOfInfinity σ ↔ AxiomOfInfinity Prop

theorem finite_rigid_power_iff (A : σ → Prop) :
    Finite (RigidPowerField A) ↔ Finite A

theorem finite_binary_rigid_field_iff (A : σ → Prop) (B : τ → Prop)
    (a : σ) (ha : A a) (b : τ) (hb : B b) :
    Finite (BinaryRigidField A B) ↔ Finite A ∧ Finite B

theorem finite_double_rigid_power (A : σ → Prop) :
    Finite (RigidPowerField (RigidPowerField A)) ↔ Finite A

theorem finite_predicates_iff (a : σ) (bf : Barcan σ) :
    Finite (fun _ : σ → Prop => True) ↔
      Finite (fun _ : σ => True) ∧ Finite (fun _ : Prop => True)

theorem infinity_predicates_iff (a : σ) (bf : Barcan σ) :
    AxiomOfInfinity (σ → Prop) ↔ AxiomOfInfinity σ ∨ AxiomOfInfinity Prop

theorem numberMap_inverse_graph_c5
    (c5 : □ (∀ p q : Prop, p ≠ q → □ (p ≠ q)))
    (w : Prop) (hw : ActualWorld w) (y : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (hy : Numbers w y) :
    ∃ n, NumberInverse (Numbers w) (numberMap w) y n ∧
      ∀ m, NumberInverse (Numbers w) (numberMap w) y m → m = n

theorem addition_iff_c5
    (c5 : □ (∀ p q : Prop, p ≠ q → □ (p ≠ q)))
    (w : Prop) (hw : ActualWorld w) (a b c : (σ → Prop) → Prop)
    (ha : FiniteCardinality a) (hb : FiniteCardinality b) (hc : FiniteCardinality c) :
    AddGraph a b c ↔ CoreAdd w (numberMap w a) (numberMap w b) (numberMap w c)

theorem multiplication_iff_c5
    (c5 : □ (∀ p q : Prop, p ≠ q → □ (p ≠ q)))
    (w : Prop) (hw : ActualWorld w) (a b c : (σ → Prop) → Prop)
    (ha : FiniteCardinality a) (hb : FiniteCardinality b) (hc : FiniteCardinality c) :
    MulGraph a b c ↔ CoreMul w (numberMap w a) (numberMap w b) (numberMap w c)

theorem count_iff_equinumerous (n : (σ → Prop) → Prop) :
    FiniteCardinality n → ∀ A : σ → Prop, n A →
      ∀ B : σ → Prop, n B ↔ Equinumerous A B

theorem hume_eq_number_c5
    (c5 : □ (∀ p q : Prop, p ≠ q → □ (p ≠ q)))
    (A : σ → Prop) (hA : Persistent A)
    (n : (σ → Prop) → Prop) (hn : FiniteCardinality n) (hnA : n A) : Hume A = n

theorem hume_identity_iff_c5
    (c5 : □ (∀ p q : Prop, p ≠ q → □ (p ≠ q)))
    (A B : σ → Prop) (hA : Persistent A) (hB : Persistent B)
    (hfA : Finite A) (hfB : Finite B) : Hume A = Hume B ↔ Equinumerous A B

theorem existence_implies_no_raw_wr_unary {σ : Type} [Ty σ] :
    Classicism.P.Existence σ → NoRawWRRelational (σ → Prop)
theorem finite_rigid_power_law {σ : Type} [Ty σ] : FiniteRigidPowerLaw σ
theorem finite_separation_law {σ τ : Type} [Ty σ] [Ty τ] : FiniteSeparationLaw σ τ

theorem arithmeticI_conversion (σ : Ty) :
    Conv (Classicism.Research.FregeArithmeticQuotation.ArithmeticCondition.term σ)
      (Classicism.Meta.arithI σ)

theorem formula_reflect (σ : Ty) {k : Nat} (φ : AForm k)
    (env : Env Classicism.e (numCtx σ k)) :
    (φ.toTerm σ).denote (Interp.ofDomain Classicism.e) env =
      readFormula φ (environment σ env)

theorem sentence_reflect (σ : Ty) (φ : AForm 0) :
    Sentence.holds (Interp.ofDomain Classicism.e) (φ.toTerm σ) =
      readSentence (σ.denote Classicism.e) φ
